wait.description: Wait for command to finish executing before continuing (before-sleep, etc.).

seat.description: Specify which seat to use. Empty string to pick arbitrarily.

events.description: List of idle events to monitor and execute commands on. See EVENTS section of swayidle(1). Items: {type: string, timeout: number, command: string, resume_command: string, description: string}. Item types: {type: string, timeout: number, command: string, resume_command: string, description: string}. Item default values: {type: 'timeout', timeout: 0, command: '', resume_command: '', description: ''}.
